name: Maou no Kuse ni Namaiki da! Torotoro Tropical!
original_name: 魔王のくせに生イキだっ！とろとろトロピカル！
source:
This is a fandisk for Maonama which takes place in between the first and second games. It’s split into three parts: the maou chapter at the beach, the maid chapter with mock weddings, and the another story for subchara-turned-heroine Lucifuges. The system is the same as the two previous games.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《魔王大人真没用！》的粉丝碟，故事发生在第一部和第二部之间。作品分为三篇：海滩上的魔王篇、包含假结婚情节的女仆篇，以及由配角转为女主角的路西法盖斯另一篇故事。系统与前两部作品相同。

[译自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
